name: Tyerkow (CR +?)
body:
A gaunt figure with pallid sinew stretched taut over exposed bone. Its body lacks skin entirely, revealing tendons and raw musculature. Lidless unblinking eyes stare with intensity.

A terrifying nocturnal predator from African folklore, the tyerkow is a vampire-like creature with a dual existence. By day, it wears its humanoid skin, blending seamlessly into city life, posing as a neighbor, passerby, or vendor. Unlike other vampires, the tyerkow can walk unscathed in sunlight as long as it wears this skin, peeling it off each night to reveal its true form. Once unskinned, the tyerkow becomes a formidable predator, possessing rapid regeneration and resistance to nonmagical weapons. Its presence carries a faint chill, as if the air itself recoils from its touch. The tyerkow stalks prey with haunting patience, lulling victims into sleep or subduing them with a gaze that fascinates, drinking blood while they sleep. Tyerkow can summon swarms of rats or cockroaches, filthy, disease-ridden extensions of its hunger.

Despite the benefits of being skinless, a tyerkow is still vulnerable. Sunlight burns it to ash if caught without its skin.

If the tyerkow’s skin is destroyed, then this undead horror disintegrates at the next dawn. Although tyerkows can walk in daylight while wearing their skin, they still favor the cover of night and often slumber during the day. These solitary beings carefully guard their hidden skins, as discovery means their doom. These creatures conceal themselves in secret sanctuaries, urban lairs tucked away from prying eyes and the deadly kiss of sunlight. Use the tyerkow Resting Places table to choose or inspire the hidden refuge where one of these undead horrors waits out the day.

Creating a Tyerkow

“Tyerkow” is an acquired template that can be added to any living creature with 5 or more Hit Dice (referred to hereafter as the base creature). Most tyerkow were once humanoids, fey, or monstrous humanoids. A tyerkow uses the base creature’s stats and abilities except as noted here.

Alignment: Any evil.

Type: The creature’s type changes to undead (augmented). Do not recalculate class Hit Dice, BAB, or saves.

Senses: A tyerkow gains darkvision 120 ft. and low-light vision.

Armor Class: Natural armor improves by 4.

Hit Dice: Change all racial Hit Dice to d8s. Class Hit Dice are unaffected. As an undead, a tyerkow uses its Charisma modifier to determine its bonus hit points (instead of Constitution).

Defensive Abilities: A tyerkow gains channel resistance +4, DR 10/magic, and immunity to cold, in addition to all of the defensive abilities granted by the undead type. A tyerkow also gains regeneration 10 (positive energy, running water, or sunlight).

Tyerkow Skin (Su)

While wearing its skin, the tyerkow doesn’t gain its improvement to natural armor, DR, and regeneration.

However, it does gain several benefits, the tyerkow is immune to being magically detected as undead, doesn’t take damage from positive energy (including holy water), and channeled energy that affects undead has no effect on it. Most importantly the tyerkow can walk unscathed in sunlight. If a creature finds and destroys the tyerkow’s skin, this removes the tyerkow’s regeneration and the tyerkow is destroyed at the next dawn, even if not exposed to sunlight. It takes a full-round action for a tyerkow to remove its skin if isn’t wearing armor. If wearing armor while trying to remove its skin, this takes half as long as the armor normally would take to remove. Putting on its skin takes 1 minute and can only done while unarmored and unclothed.

Weaknesses: Being fully immersed in running water deals 10d6 points of damage per round to a tyerkow. Each round a tyerkow is exposed to direct sunlight while not wearing its skin, it is staggered and takes 10d6 points of damage.

Speed: Same as the base creature. If the base creature has a swim speed, the tyerkow is not harmed by running water.

Melee: A tyerkow gains a bite attack and a slam attack if the base creature doesn’t already have them. Damage depends on the vampire’s size, a Medium tyerkow’s bite deals 1d6 damage and its slam deals 1d4 damage. A tyerkow’s natural weapons are treated as magic weapons for the purpose of overcoming damage reduction.

Special Attacks: A tyerkow gains several special attacks. Its save DCs are equal to 10 + 1/2 the tyerkow’s Hit Dice + the tyerkow’s Cha modifier unless otherwise noted.

Blood Drain (Ex)

A tyerkow can suck blood from a helpless, willing, or grappled living victim with its fangs by making a successful grapple check. If it pins the foe, it drains blood, draining 1d4 points of Constitution each round the pin is maintained. On each round it drains blood, the tyerkow gains 5 temporary hit points that last for 1 hour (up to a maximum number of temporary hit points equal to its full normal hit points).

Blood Hypnosis (Su)

As a standard action, a tyerkow targets a living creature within 30 feet that can see the tyerkow. The target must succeed on a Will save or gain the fascinated condition for 1 minute. After a creature has been fascinated by this ability, it is immune to its effects for 24 hours. This is a mind-affecting effect.

Soporific Gaze (Su)

As a standard action, a tyerkow can fix its gaze on a living creature within 30 feet, ushering the target into unnatural slumber. The target must succeed on a Will save or fall instantly asleep for 1 minute, as though affected by a deep slumber spell (caster level 10th). A tyerkow can use blood drain on a creature put to sleep by soporific gaze without waking it. This can affect a creature of any HD and is a mind-affecting sleep effect.

Nightchill Strike (Su)

The tyerkow’s attack carries the essence of deathly frost. Once per round when a tyerkow hits with a slam attack or with a melee weapon, the attack deals 3d6 points of cold damage, plus an additional 1d6 cold damage for every 2 Hit Dice the creature possesses beyond 5.

Summon Vermin (Su)

Once per day, a tyerkow can call forth a swarm of diseased rats or cockroaches as a standard action. These appear in an unoccupied space within 30 feet of the tyerkow and act on the tyerkow’s next turn. The swarm obeys the tyerkow’s commands for 1 hour then vanishes. This swarm also carries an insidious disease:

Tyerkow Filth: Swarm—injury; save Fort DC 14; onset 1 day; frequency 1/day; effect 1 Con damage, target cannot heal naturally and takes a –2 penalty on Fort saves and Constitution checks; cure 2 consecutive saves. The save DC is Constitution-based.

Ability Scores: Str +4, Dex +4, Wis +2, Cha +2. As an undead creature, a tyerkow has no Constitution score.

Skills: A tyerkow gains a +8 racial bonus on Bluff, Disguise, Perception, and Stealth checks.

Feats: A tyerkow gains Alertness, Improved Initiative, and Toughness as bonus feats.
